scenarios.title: Cloud Platform Monthly Uptime Alignment
scenarios.rationale: The commercial commitment is directly backed by the technical specification with aligned parameters.
scenarios.topEvidence: Production clusters are engineered to deliver 99.95% monthly platform availability across all production regions.

scenarios.title: Data Encryption At Rest and In Transit Alignment
scenarios.rationale: The commercial commitment is directly backed by the technical specification with aligned parameters.
scenarios.topEvidence: Storage volumes encrypt all customer data at rest using AES-256 and enforce TLS 1.3 for all in-transit traffic.

scenarios.title: Critical Incident P1 Response Time Alignment
scenarios.rationale: The commercial commitment is directly backed by the technical specification with aligned parameters.
scenarios.topEvidence: The 24/7 support operations center acknowledges P1 critical incidents within 15 minutes of ticket creation.

scenarios.title: Disaster Recovery RPO 15 Minutes Alignment
scenarios.rationale: The commercial commitment is directly backed by the technical specification with aligned parameters.
scenarios.topEvidence: Asynchronous cross-region replication maintains a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 15 minutes.

scenarios.title: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 Certification Alignment
scenarios.rationale: The commercial commitment is directly backed by the technical specification with aligned parameters.
scenarios.topEvidence: Independent third-party auditors certify the platform annually under SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 standards.

scenarios.title: API Throughput 2000 req/s Alignment
scenarios.rationale: The commercial commitment is directly backed by the technical specification with aligned parameters.
scenarios.topEvidence: Gateway rate limiters allocate 2000 req/s sustained API throughput per production tenant.

scenarios.title: 99.99% Proposal Uptime vs 99.5% Spec Target
scenarios.rationale: The commercial proposal promises 99.99% whereas the technical specification states 99.5%.
scenarios.topEvidence: The platform targets 99.5% monthly uptime availability, excluding planned maintenance windows.

scenarios.title: 3 Months Go-Live Promise vs 7 Months Spec Roadmap
scenarios.rationale: The proposal commits to 3 months while the technical specification defines 7 months.
scenarios.topEvidence: Full production deployment across Phases 1 to 3 requires 7 months including acceptance testing.

scenarios.title: 24/7 Support Promise vs Business Hours Spec
scenarios.rationale: The proposal promises 24/7 coverage whereas the specification restricts support to standard business hours.
scenarios.topEvidence: Live engineering support is available during standard business hours (Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm CET).

scenarios.title: Zero Data Loss Promise vs 4 Hours RPO Spec
scenarios.rationale: The proposal claims zero data loss (RPO = 0) while the technical specification defines a non-zero Recovery Point Objective.
scenarios.topEvidence: Database snapshots run every 4 hours, resulting in a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 4 hours.

scenarios.title: Dedicated Single-Tenant Promise vs Shared Multi-Tenant Spec
scenarios.rationale: The proposal promises dedicated or single-tenant isolation whereas the technical architecture uses shared multi-tenant infrastructure.
scenarios.topEvidence: All customer workloads are hosted on a shared multi-tenant Kubernetes cluster with logical namespace separation.

scenarios.title: 7 Years Audit Log Retention vs 90 Days Spec Limit
scenarios.rationale: The proposal commits to 7 years while the technical specification defines 90 days.
scenarios.topEvidence: Audit trail logs are retained online for 90 days before automatic purge.
